name: doodle
description: A local-first shared infinite board for people and AI, packaged as a desktop-only Codex plugin and MCP server.

interface.longDescription: Doodle Shared Board is a local-first shared infinite canvas for people and AI. A person and an agent place notes, text, shapes, and directed arrows on one canvas through four focused MCP tools inside a desktop-only Codex plugin. MCP Apps rendering is optional; conversation stays in the host chat. Project structure is only one possible subject, and the board never writes project files.
defaultPrompt: 打开 Doodle 画板，放一张便签，我来改给你看。
